def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque

    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background)
    line_color = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if seen[sr][sc] or grid[sr][sc] == line_color:
                continue
            comp = []
            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen[sr][sc] = True
            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                comp.append((r, c))
                for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                    if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and not seen[nr][nc]
                            and grid[nr][nc] != line_color):
                        seen[nr][nc] = True
                        q.append((nr, nc))

            r0 = min(r for r, c in comp)
            r1 = max(r for r, c in comp)
            c0 = min(c for r, c in comp)
            c1 = max(c for r, c in comp)
            cells = set(comp)

            corners = [
                (r0, c0, 1, 1),
                (r0, c1, 1, -1),
                (r1, c0, -1, 1),
                (r1, c1, -1, -1),
            ]

            def corner_score(spec):
                r, c, dr, dc = spec
                vals = []
                while (r, c) in cells:
                    vals.append(grid[r][c])
                    r += dr
                    c += dc
                nonbg = sum(v != background for v in vals)
                first = bool(vals and vals[0] != background)
                return (first, nonbg)

            r, c, dr, dc = max(corners, key=corner_score)
            vals = []
            while (r, c) in cells:
                vals.append(grid[r][c])
                r += dr
                c += dc

            seq = []
            if vals:
                seq.append(vals[0])
                started = vals[0] != background
                for v in vals[1:]:
                    if v == background:
                        if started:
                            break
                    else:
                        seq.append(v)
                        started = True
            if not seq:
                seq = [background]

            for rr, cc in comp:
                depth = min(rr - r0, r1 - rr, cc - c0, c1 - cc)
                out[rr][cc] = seq[depth % len(seq)]

    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    wall = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]

    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if seen[sr][sc] or grid[sr][sc] == wall:
                continue
            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen[sr][sc] = True
            comp = []
            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                comp.append((r, c))
                for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                    if (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and not seen[rr][cc]
                            and grid[rr][cc] != wall):
                        seen[rr][cc] = True
                        q.append((rr, cc))

            r0 = min(r for r, c in comp)
            r1 = max(r for r, c in comp)
            c0 = min(c for r, c in comp)
            c1 = max(c for r, c in comp)
            cells = set(comp)
            candidates = []
            for cr, cc, dr, dc in ((r0,c0,1,1),(r0,c1,1,-1),
                                   (r1,c0,-1,1),(r1,c1,-1,-1)):
                candidates.append((cr,cc,dr,dc))
                # A region beginning immediately after a separator can have
                # its first diagonal color on that separator.
                if 0 <= cr-dr < h and 0 <= cc-dc < w and grid[cr-dr][cc-dc] == wall:
                    candidates.append((cr-dr,cc-dc,dr,dc))

            best = []
            best_n = -1
            for r, c, dr, dc in candidates:
                vals = []
                first = True
                while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and ((r,c) in cells or (first and grid[r][c] == wall)):
                    vals.append(grid[r][c])
                    first = False
                    r += dr
                    c += dc
                n = sum(v != bg and v != wall or (i == 0 and v == wall and v != bg)
                        for i, v in enumerate(vals))
                # The starting cell always encodes a color, even when it is
                # also the separator color.
                n = sum(v != bg for v in vals)
                if vals and vals[0] == wall:
                    n += 1
                if n > best_n:
                    best_n = n
                    best = vals

            if not best:
                continue
            last = max(i for i, v in enumerate(best)
                       if v != bg or i == 0)
            seq = best[:last+1]
            for r, c in comp:
                d = min(r-r0, r1-r, c-c0, c1-c)
                out[r][c] = seq[d] if d < len(seq) else bg
    return out
